win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 Land 8 or more symbols of the same kind anywhere on the grid to get a winning combination.

 After every win the winning symbols are removed and new ones drop in. This continues until there are no more new wins on the reels.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
Activate this bonus feature with 10 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 During each spin, all wins will be collected and displayed above the reels as a pending win amount. That amount will be updated after every cascade that awards a new win. If you land one or more multipliers their values will be added together and applied to the total win at the end of each spin.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time awards extra free spins:

 2 FS awards +2 free spins.

 3 FS awards +4 free spins.

scatters.name: DIVINE BOOST
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus feature with 10 free spins by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 In this bonus game, a progressive Divine Multiplier collects all multiplier values that are a part of a win before adding it to the total win; these multipliers are then stored in the progressive Divine Multiplier portal and increase with each following winning spin containing multiplier symbols.

 All following multiplier values will first be added to the Divine Multiplier portal and then the new total will be added to the Total Win bar.

 If there is a win, but no multipliers on the grid, the Divine Multiplier stays inactive.

 If there are multipliers on the grid, but no wins, the multipliers are not added to the Divine Multiplier and it stays inactive.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time awards extra free spins:

 2 FS awards +2 free spins;

 3 FS awards +4 free spins.

multipliers.name: MULTIPLIER SYMBOLS
multipliers.behavior:
Multiplier symbols activate at the end of each spin, if there has been at least one win during the spin. The multiplier symbols will first add together, then the resulting value will be multiplied by the total win amount to form the win. Multiplier symbols can have a maximum value of 10,000x.

 There are three types of Multiplier Symbols:

 Normal Multiplier Symbol: Will land with the multiplier value visible and increase by +1 with every new cascade! Possible initial values: 2x, 3x, 4x

 Super Multiplier Symbol: Will land with a ?-character. The symbol’s value will be revealed when it activates. The symbol’s value will increase by +2 on every new cascade! Possible initial values: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x

 Epic Multiplier Symbol: Will land with its initial value revealed. The symbol’s value will double on every new cascade! Possible initial values: 5x, 10x, 50x, 100x
